mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM review_plans WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND concept_id = #{conceptId} AND status = 'TODO' )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review_plans (user_id, concept_id, plan_date, status, reason, created_at) SELECT #{userId}, #{conceptId}, #{planDate}, 'TODO', #{reason}, #{createdAt} FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM review_plans WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND concept_id = #{conceptId} AND plan_date = #{planDate} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
